findings.where: list section, tasting section and Find us footer, all widths
findings.evidence: Three dashed missing-fact slots on one page: "The full list: link to come.", "The next date is to be announced.", "Address to be announced". The data_slots detector did not count them because they are not literal [DATA NEEDED] text.
findings.before: "link to come" / "to be announced" / "Address to be announced"
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: street address] at minimum; publish the list link and the next tasting date, or cut the list link until it exists
findings.why: More than two slots means the page was built before its content existed; the page's two jobs (come in, book a tasting) both end at a missing fact.
findings.title: At most two missing-fact slots
findings.fix: Get the content, or cut the sections that need it.

findings.evidence: Heading "Find us after five." at display size is followed only by "Address to be announced" and two footer links; the hero's secondary CTA "Find us" and the nav item both land here.
findings.before: "Find us after five." + "Address to be announced"
findings.after: [DATA NEEDED: street address, nearest station, map link]; until then drop the "Find us" CTA from the hero and nav
findings.why: A section whose heading promises a place and gives none reads as a template slot; the visitor who clicks "Find us" learns nothing.
findings.title: Cut a row, column or line that would hold only a missing fact

findings.evidence: Static text "Open tonight from 5pm" sits in the header, while the hours table says Monday to Wednesday are "Closed". The capture shows no script making it conditional.
findings.after: Compute it from the day ("Open tonight from 5pm" / "Closed tonight, open Thursday"), or replace with the fixed "Thu to Sun from 5pm"
findings.why: A status line that is false three nights a week is invented state, and it is the first fact many visitors read.
findings.title: Framing must not distort the fact
